newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Friday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt lower.

Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,000 slaughter steers and 1,800 heifers after a weekly movement of 79,900. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 67.00.
